name: u_natural
cite: Natural-uranium tamper, layer C-103 (research doc Trinity technical reference; ~108-111 kg, ~6.56 cm thick). Isotopic abundances U-238 99.2742 / U-235 0.7204 / U-234 0.0054 atom% (IUPAC/public). alpha-uranium metal density 19.05 g/cm3 (public); see data/materials/README.md for the mass-deviation record.
